input.summary: Implemented a TypeScript Task Management API per the specification. Files created: src/types.ts (data and service contracts), src/event-bus.ts (EventBus), services/user-service.ts, services/project-service.ts, services/task-service.ts, services/comment-service.ts, services/notification-service.ts, src/router.ts (HTTP router using Node http), src/main.ts (wires event subscriptions and starts server), src/demo.ts (demo script exercising features), tsconfig.json, package.json. Services own private in-memory Maps, services communicate via EventBus, TaskService enforces forward-only status transitions, router handles all HTTP. Note: attempted to run tsc but TypeScript compiler isn't available in the environment; sources are written and TypeScript configuration added.
